newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Doctors say Zaire rebels kill 34 hospital patients.
newsitem.headline: Doctors say Zaire rebels kill 34 hospital patients.

text.p: Zairean doctors said on Wednesday ethnic Tutsi Banyamulenge rebels killed a total of 34 patients and six staff at a hospital in eastern Zaire over the weekend.
Two doctors told reporters in the border town of Bukavu 100 Banyamulenge militiamen arrived at the hospital in Lemera town to the south on Saturday night and attacked for eight hours.
"The Banyamulenge arrived at the hospital and opened fire. They killed 28 patients in their beds, 34 patients in all, and four male nurses and two doctors," Dr Aubin Mulaga told reporters.
The doctors said the Banyamulenge attacked because the hospital was treating Hutu war wounded from the conflict between the Zairean army, Banyamulenge and local Zairean tribes.
"We are medical persons and we don't have the right to distinguish between patients. But it is true we had Hutu wounded and no Banyamulenge patients," said Mulaga who escaped unharmed.
